<!-- pr-reviewer: 80a3ce851df2abf1c74bd285f36d1877bb13a261 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Sign cannot flip. The closed form only replaces the unsigned magnitude in `mag_at` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field.rs:186`). Every reader wears the parity sign through `signed(mag, inside)` (`field.rs:179`, `march.rs:125`, `preview/pack.rs:155,188`, `preview/march.rs:82`). Parity still comes from the shell, so inside/outside is decided exactly as before. A magnitude of 0 still reads 0.
- The 2-cell magnitude tolerance cannot change a verdict. The old BFS value was a graph distance, at or above the true distance by up to 2 cells (`field_gen.rs:111-118`). The new value is the exact distance, clamped to `cap` (`field_box.rs:50`), so it is never larger. A mesh term's sign comes from parity alone, and `max(mesh, cut)` is positive only if one operand is. The magnitude only sets the interpolated surface height in the march, and that is now closer to the truth. The heavy agreement lane confirms 0 findings.
- Nothing reads `bricks` directly for the mesh layer except `region_of`. `region_of` unions the shell bounds padded by `cap/cell + 3`, which covers every cell where the box magnitude is below `cap` (`field_batch.rs:164-190`). The empty brick map therefore does not shrink the cut region.
- Cylinder and model stocks are untouched (`analytic: None`, same `mag_at` result as before).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new source. `from_box` runs `validate_shell`, so degenerate boxes and non-finite or non-positive cells still refuse by name. Provenance line and decision record are present. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes. `field_box.rs` is 75 lines.

**Local results** (trial-merged with fresh `upstream/main`, merged without conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` (debug, whole crate) | all pass, 0 failed (includes `field_block_cost` 2 + 1 ignored, `stock_sdf` and `stock_sdf_cut` families, `stock_backend_parity`, `stock_columns`, `stock_preview`, `stock_bull_nose`, `wall_slack`, `headless_bin`) |
| release `field_block_cost --include-ignored` | 3/3, including the 2 s wall-time budget |
| release `stock_backend_parity --include-ignored` | 13/13 |
| release `camcraft-app` `stock_engine_agreement --include-ignored` | 3/3, every program and plane "findings 0" |
| release `camcraft-app` `stock_field_cost --include-ignored` | 1/1, total 11.0 s on this machine (PR reports 7.6 s) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

I did not rebuild the app and ui suites. The diff does not touch those crates, and the engine consumers ran through the app lanes above.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. `backend_build.rs`: the new `SdfField::from_box(...)` call line is over rustfmt width. A `cargo fmt` pass would tidy it.
2. `field_block_cost.rs` asserts only "within 2 cells" against the band fill. The measured agreement is exact in the golden lanes, so a tighter bound (the closed form is `<=` the band value) would pin the property better. Optional.
3. The sampled lattice in `the_closed_form_reads_the_stock_the_band_fill_read` is only cell centres. A few points off the lattice and on the faces would also cover the `signed` zero case. Optional.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
